top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Colonia's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
GFNY Colonia's rolling riverfront roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

GFNY Colonia's rolling riverfront roads rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 77 miles.
77 miles on rolling riverfront roads burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Colonia. Train it until it feels boring.
At GFNY Colonia, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
When someone attacks on rolling riverfront roads, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Colonia. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling riverfront roads. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Colonia's rolling riverfront roads actually does to you.
Varied gradients on rolling riverfront roads demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Colonia's 77 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, carry enough for gaps between stops, and confirm the organizer’s current resupply locations before race day.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Colonia rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling riverfront roads to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, TT Threshold, and Road Specific to prepare you for 77 miles of rolling riverfront roads in Colonia del Sacramento, Uruguay.
